instructions:
FlowState is the user's project memory (todos, changes, decisions, problems, learnings).
1. At the start of every conversation about a project, call start_here(project="<name>") first and read the brief. If you don't know the project, call start_here() with no arguments (or with folder="<working folder>") to see the list, then pick one.
2. As you work, record what matters with log_work(project="<name>", kind=..., summary=...): kind=decision for choices made, change for things changed, problem for bugs/blockers, learning for lessons, todo for follow-ups. One short line each; add details only when useful.
3. Every write must name the project. Never put passwords, tokens or keys in any text. If you know your model name, pass it as model="<name>" on writes; never guess or invent it (leave it out).
4. A session is opened and closed for you automatically; you don't need to manage it. Its auto-captured summary, and anything you log with suggested=true, waits in a review queue for the user. Never approve or reject review items unless the user explicitly asks you to in this chat. The user's review mode (shown in the brief) decides what else waits; never change it unless the user asks you to in this chat.
5. Things shared between projects (a protocol, a library) are linked with the link tool; log changes to a shared component by its name and the other projects are alerted.
6. The brief starts with the project's HARD RULES: never break them. If it shows a HANDOFF note, continue from it and mark it picked up (handoff action=pickup). If you must stop mid-task, leave one: handoff(action="leave", project=..., where_i_was=..., next_step=...).
7. If FlowState is slow, errors, or is unavailable, tell the user once and carry on with their task without it. Never retry more than once.

prompts.description: Load FlowState project memory and work with it for this conversation.
prompts.name: flowstate-start

tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST in every conversation about a project, before get_context or list_projects. Returns a text brief (standard max 4,000 characters; size=quick about 1,500; size=deep up to 12,000) with hard rules (never break them), any handoff, open todos and problems, recent changes, decisions and learnings, and opens a session. project is a name or id. With no project, or only folder (its name is matched to a project), returns the project list as text instead of a brief. Does not log work; use log_work.

folder.description: Working folder path. Used only when project is omitted; the folder's name is matched to a project.

project.description: Project name or id. Omit, or pass only folder, to get the project list instead of a brief.

size.description: quick (about 1,500 characters), standard (default, 4,000) or deep (up to 12,000).

tools.name: start_here

tools.description: Record work as you go (write; project required). Prefer this over log_learning, log_change, problem action=log and todo action=add. kind: decision (a choice made and why), change (something changed), problem (bug or blocker), learning (lesson or gotcha), todo (follow-up). summary: one short line. details: optional. component: optional component name (changes and problems default to 'General'). suggested=true: you are not sure the user wants this recorded, so it goes to the review queue instead of being saved. priority (todos; severity for problems): critical, urgent, normal (default), low. source: user_stated (the user said it), ai_inferred (your conclusion) or from_code (read in code or commits). Never include secrets (writes containing keys, tokens or passwords are refused). Returns {logged, project_id, record}, or {queued_for_review, kind} when suggested or the review mode holds that kind. A new record is not deleted by history undo.

category.description: Learnings only: pattern, gotcha, best_practice, tool_tip, architecture, performance, security or other.

component.description: Component name. changes and problems default to General, created if missing. Others: optional.

details.description: Optional longer reason or context. Omit if the summary is enough.

kind.description: decision, change, problem, learning or todo. Required.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

priority.description: Todos: priority. Problems: severity. critical, urgent, normal (default), low; older names high/medium also work.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

replaces.description: Decisions only: id of the earlier decision this one replaces

source.description: Where it comes from: user_stated, ai_inferred, from_code

suggested.description: true = put it in the review queue for the user instead of saving it

summary.description: One short line: the decision, change, problem, lesson or todo. Required.

tools.name: log_work

tools.description: List items waiting in the review queue (auto-captured session summaries, records logged with suggested=true, and kinds the review mode holds). Read-only. Show them to the user; approve or reject only with review_approve / review_reject when they ask. status: pending (default), approved, rejected or all. limit default 20 (max 100); project optional. Returns {items: [{id, project, kind, status, summary, details, source, created_at}], total, status}.

project.description: Project name or id (optional: all projects)

tools.name: review_list

tools.description: Approve a review item so it becomes a normal FlowState record (a session summary is written onto that session instead). To edit then approve, pass the corrected summary/details (or priority/category/component). move_to places a misfiled item in another project. Returns {approved, kind, edited, record: {table, id}}. Undo later edits with history; undo does not delete the new record. ONLY call this when the user has explicitly told you, in this chat, to approve or reject this specific item. Never decide on your own initiative, and never approve your own suggestions unless the user explicitly says so. user_request must quote the user's words. Write: requires project="<name>".

category.description: For a learning: pattern, gotcha, best_practice, tool_tip, architecture, performance, security or other.

component.description: Component name to file the approved record under. Optional.

details.description: Replacement details. Omit to keep the queued details.

item_id.description: Review item id from review_list. Required.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

move_to.description: Clean-up 'misfiled' items: the project to move it to, if not the suggested one

priority.description: For a todo or problem: critical, urgent, normal or low (high and medium also work).

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

summary.description: Replacement summary. Omit to keep the queued text.

user_request.description: The user's own words in this chat asking for this decision

tools.name: review_approve

tools.description: Reject a review item. It is kept, marked rejected, with the user's reason (nothing is deleted). Returns {rejected, kind, reason}. ONLY call this when the user has explicitly told you, in this chat, to approve or reject this specific item. Never decide on your own initiative, and never approve your own suggestions unless the user explicitly says so. user_request must quote the user's words. Write: requires project="<name>".

item_id.description: Review item id from review_list. Required.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

reason.description: Why the user rejected it, in their words. Required. Kept on the item; nothing is deleted.

user_request.description: The user's own words in this chat asking for this decision

tools.name: review_reject

tools.description: Link things across projects (write for add/remove; project required). Use when projects share something, e.g. several apps use one protocol: link(action="add", project="App A", link_type="uses", target_project="Owner", target_component="Wire Protocol"). Source is the project, or component="<name in project>", or item_type+item_id (decision, change, learning, problem, todo). Target: target_project (+ target_component), target_type+target_id, or url (a GitHub/Linear link to keep on a record). link_type: uses, depends_on, part_of, same_as, supersedes, subtask_of, blocks, about or url. Changes logged on a shared component alert every project linked to it (an update todo + a note in its brief). FlowState only alerts; it does not change other apps' code. remove: link_id (or the add fields) deletes the link; history undo (record_type=link) puts it back. list (read) returns the project's links. add returns the new link. Record a change to a shared component with log_work, not with link.

action.description: add (create a link), remove (delete one) or list (read). Required.

component.description: Source: a component of project, by name

include_removed.description: list: true also returns removed links (default false).

item_id.description: Source record id. Use with item_type. remove can use this instead of link_id.

link_id.description: remove: link id from list. Omit if you repeat the add fields.

link_type.description: uses, depends_on, part_of, same_as, supersedes, subtask_of, blocks, about or url. Required for add.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

note.description: add: optional short note stored on the link.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

target_id.description: add: target record id. Use with target_type.

target_project.description: add: target project name or id, with target_component or alone.

target_type.description: add: target record type (project, component, decision, change, learning, problem, todo). Use with target_id.

url.description: add: https URL (GitHub, Linear or similar) stored on the source record.

tools.name: link

tools.description: Read or change the review mode: which new records wait in the review queue for the user's OK. Modes: off (nothing waits), auto_only (default: only auto-captured items), types (also the listed kinds), everything. action=get is read-only. action=set ONLY when the user has explicitly asked you, in this chat, to change the review mode; never change it on your own initiative or to get your writes saved. user_request must quote the user's words; every change is logged with them. project=... sets an override for one project (clear=true removes it); no project = the whole install.

action.description: get (read the mode) or set (change it; user must ask). Required.

kinds.description: mode=types: which kinds wait for review

mode.description: set: off (nothing waits), auto_only (default), types (also kinds) or everything. Ignored when clear=true.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Optional: one project's override (default: whole install)

user_request.description: The user's own words in this chat asking for this decision

tools.name: review_mode

tools.description: Edit history of FlowState records, and undo. action=list (read): recent edits and deletes in a project, or of one record (record_type + record_id), with old and new values. action=undo (write; project required): put back the last change to that record (a deleted record comes back); recorded too, so undoing again redoes it. Refused if the record changed again since. New records are not undone here (set them done/cancelled). action=who (read): who did what, newest first, across projects or one project: app, model, machine and how the app was identified, for edits, review decisions, links, handoffs, rules and new records; filters by_app, by_model, by_machine, since, until (local time, e.g. 2026-10-17 or 2026-10-17 14:30), page. list returns {history, count} with old/new fields; undo returns {undone, rows}; who returns {rows, total, page}. For what was logged as a change, use get_recent_changes, not history.

action.description: list (edits), undo (revert the last edit of one record) or who (who did what). Required.

by_app.description: who: only this app (part of the name)

by_model.description: who: only this model (part of the name)

limit.description: list/who: max rows (default 20, capped at 100). who uses it as the page size.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

record_id.description: list: optional, with record_type. undo: the record's id. Required for undo.

record_type.description: list/undo: todo, project, component, problem, solution, attempt, variable, method, attachment, link, learning, decision or change. Required for undo.

since.description: who: from this local time, e.g. 2026-10-17

until.description: who: up to this local time

tools.name: history

tools.description: Find likely duplicates, stale todos and records filed in the wrong project, and put them in the review queue as suggestions (write; project required; additive: nothing is moved, closed or deleted). The user approves or rejects each one; approving applies only that suggestion and it can be undone with history. Suggestions the user rejected are not repeated. kinds: any of duplicate, stale, misfiled (default all). Returns {queued, item_ids, already_suggested, found, examples}. Applying one is review_approve, not this tool.

kinds.description: Which checks: duplicate, stale, misfiled. Omit for all three.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

tools.name: cleanup_suggest

tools.description: Bring memories or notes into a project's REVIEW QUEUE (write; project required; nothing is saved as a record until the user approves). format=memory (default): a Claude or ChatGPT memory export or copy, as text/markdown (one per line) or JSON. format=flowstate_markdown: a file made by `flowstate export-md`; new lines and edited lines become review items. Pass the file's contents as text. Lines that look like secrets are skipped, not stored. format=memory returns {found, queued, secrets_skipped, duplicates_skipped}; flowstate_markdown returns counts of new, edits, unchanged and secrets_skipped. One new note is log_work, not import.

format.description: memory (default): Claude/ChatGPT export or lines. flowstate_markdown: a flowstate export-md file.

kind.description: format=memory: record kind for the items

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

source.description: Where it came from, e.g. Claude, ChatGPT

tools.name: import_memory

tools.description: A project's HARD RULES: things never to do in it (e.g. "Never push to main"). They are shown first in every start_here brief, in full. action=list (read). action=add (write; project required): rule = one short sentence (max 300 characters; 2,000 per project); add one when the user states a rule. action=remove (write): rule_id, ONLY when the user asks you in this chat; user_request must quote their words. remove keeps the text, marked removed. list returns {rules, count, characters_used, characters_max}. A one-off choice is log_work kind=decision, not a rule.

action.description: add (write a rule), list (read) or remove (mark removed; user must ask). Required.

include_removed.description: list: true includes removed rules (default false).

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

rule.description: add: the rule, one short sentence

rule_id.description: remove: the rule (R<id> in the brief)

user_request.description: The user's own words in this chat asking for this decision

tools.name: rules

tools.description: Handoff notes between AIs. Stopping mid-task (out of time, context or tokens, or the user ends the chat)? action=leave (write; project required) with where_i_was (what was being done and its state) and next_step. The next AI sees it first in start_here. When you continue from a note, action=pickup with handoff_id so it stops showing (returns {picked_up: true}). action=list (read) returns {handoffs, count}. leave returns {handoff_id}. This is not a session summary; sessions close on their own.

action.description: leave (write a note), list (read) or pickup (stop showing a note). Required.

handoff_id.description: pickup: the note (H<id> in the brief)

include_picked_up.description: list: true includes notes already picked up (default false).

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

next_step.description: leave: the very next thing to do (max 500)

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

where_i_was.description: leave: what you were doing and how far it got (max 1,000)

tools.name: handoff

tools.description: Keep facts current. action=stale (read): facts (paths, ports, hosts, URLs, config) in a project not checked for 60+ days; check them. action=mark (write): you confirmed a record still holds (record_type + record_id; optional source). action=source (write): set where a record came from: user_stated, ai_inferred or from_code. If a fact changed, log the change with log_work instead. stale returns {stale, total, stale_after_days} and writes nothing. mark and source return that record's provenance.

action.description: stale (read facts not re-checked), mark (you confirmed one) or source (set where it came from). Required.

days.description: stale: not checked for this many days (default 60, or FLOWSTATE_STALE_DAYS).

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

record_id.description: mark/source: id of that record. Required for those actions.

record_type.description: mark/source: todo, decision, change, learning, problem, variable or method. Required for those actions.

source.description: source: required, user_stated, ai_inferred or from_code. mark: optional, stored only if passed.

tools.name: verify

tools.description: Ask FlowState a question in plain words (read-only), e.g. "which port does the LAN server use?". Returns a short answer quoted from the best-matching records, with their ids (type #id), plus matching hard rules and handoff notes. Local only (meaning search if a local model is installed, keywords otherwise). If nothing matches it says so; it never guesses. project optional (default: all projects). Returns {question, answer, sources: [{type, id, project, text}], mode}. To list matches without an answer, use search.

project.description: Project name or id. Omit to search every project.

question.description: The question in plain words. Required. Example: which port does the LAN server use?

tools.name: ask

tools.description: List every FlowState project (read-only), newest update first. Use start_here to open one project's brief; use this for the structured list or a status filter. Returns [{id, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at}]. Does not create or change projects.

status.description: Only this status: active, paused, completed or archived. Omit for all.

tools.name: list_projects

tools.description: Create a new FlowState project (write). Use when the user asks for a project; recording work inside one is log_work, and opening it is start_here. name must be unique. Returns {id, name, description, status: active, created_at, updated_at}. A duplicate name is rejected. No components or records are created with it.

description.description: Optional longer description. Omit to leave it empty.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

tools.name: create_project

tools.description: Change an existing project's name, description or status (write). Only fields you pass are overwritten. name must stay unique. Returns the project. Restore the previous row with history undo (record_type=project, record_id=project_id). Does not move that project's records. Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

description.description: New description. Omit to keep the current one.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

name.description: New unique name. Omit to keep the current name.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

status.description: active, paused, completed or archived. Omit to keep the current status.

tools.name: update_project

tools.description: Read a raw context dump for one project by exact name (read-only). Prefer start_here to begin work: it includes hard rules and handoffs and opens the session. lean=true (default) returns {project: {id, name, status}, stats, blocking (up to 3 critical or urgent problems), quick_todos (up to 3 pending titles), recent_focus, has_active_session}. lean=false returns the project, components, open problems, changes within hours (default 48), pending todos, up to 10 learnings, the current session and attachments. An unknown name returns null.

hours.description: How many hours of changes to include (default 48).

lean.description: true (default): short counts and titles. false: full objects.

project_name.description: Exact project name. Required. Ids are not accepted; use start_here for a name or id.

tools.name: get_context

tools.description: Add a component, a named part of a project such as a service or module (write). Changes and problems attach to one. name must be unique in the project. Returns {id, project_id, name, description, parent_component_id, status: in_progress, timestamps}. To record that something changed, use log_work(kind=change), not a new component. Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

name.description: Component name, unique within the project. Required.

parent_component_id.description: Optional parent component id in the same project, to nest it.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

project_id.description: Project that owns the component. Required (or project= name).

tools.name: create_component

tools.description: List one project's components by name (read-only). Each item is {id, project_id, parent_component_id, name, description, status, created_at, updated_at}. status is planning, in_progress, testing, complete or deprecated. Pass an id to log_change or problem. For the working brief, call start_here.

project_id.description: Project id whose components to list. Required.

tools.name: list_components

tools.description: Overwrite a component's name, description or status (write). Only fields you pass change. Returns the component, or null if the id does not exist. Restore the previous row with history undo (record_type=component). This does not write a change record; use log_work(kind=change) for that. Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

description.description: New description. Omit to keep the current one.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

name.description: New name. Omit to keep the current name. Must stay unique in the project.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

status.description: planning, in_progress, testing, complete or deprecated. Omit to keep the current status.

tools.name: update_component

tools.description: Save a lesson on a project (write). Prefer log_work(kind=learning, summary=the insight); use this when you want category and context on the row. Returns the learning {id, project_id, insight, category, context, source, verified: false}. If the review mode holds learnings, it is queued instead of saved. Secrets are refused. A new learning is not removed by history undo. Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

category.description: pattern, gotcha, best_practice, tool_tip, architecture, performance, security or other. Omit for none.

component_id.description: Optional component id this lesson is about.

insight.description: The lesson, one or two sentences. Required.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

source.description: experience (default), documentation, conversation, error or research.

tools.name: log_learning

tools.description: List saved lessons (read-only). Omit filters to list every project. compact=true drops empty fields and timestamps and truncates long text to 100 characters. Returns learning objects {id, insight, category, context, source, verified, ...}. To ask a question, use ask; to search every record type, use search.

category.description: Only this category: pattern, gotcha, best_practice, tool_tip, architecture, performance, security or other.

compact.description: true: drop empties and timestamps, truncate long text (default false).

project_id.description: Only this project's lessons. Omit for all projects.

tools.name: get_learnings

tools.description: Append a change record on a component (write). Prefer log_work(kind=change, summary=what changed, component=name); it alerts linked projects the same way. component_id may be omitted; the project's General component is used or created. Returns the change {id, component_id, field_name, old_value, new_value, change_type, reason}, plus alerted_projects when other projects link to it. Review mode may queue it instead. Creating it is not undone by history. Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

change_type.description: config, code, architecture, dependency, documentation or other. Omit to store none.

component_id.description: Component that changed. Omit to use or create the project's General component.

field_name.description: What changed, a short label (the summary). Required.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

tools.name: log_change

tools.description: List change records from the last hours (default 24), for one project and/or component (read-only). This is what was logged as changed, not the edit history of FlowState rows. For old/new values of an edit, who changed a row, or undo, use history. compact=true shortens text and drops timestamps. Returns changes {id, component_id, field_name, old_value, new_value, change_type, reason, created_at}.

compact.description: true: drop empties and timestamps, truncate long text (default false).

component_id.description: Only changes on this component. Omit for every component.

project_id.description: Only changes in this project. Omit for every project.

tools.name: get_recent_changes

tools.description: Find records by words across todos, decisions, changes, learnings, problems and solutions (read-only). Word endings match. mode=auto (default) also ranks by meaning when a local model is installed; the reply's mode is keywords or meaning+keywords. For a quoted answer to a question, use ask. Returns {query, mode, count, results: [{content_type, content_id, project, title, snippet, matched_by}], note?}. limit default 10, capped at 50.

content_types.description: Only these types: todo, decision, change, learning, problem, solution. Omit for all six.

mode.description: auto (default): meaning plus keywords when a local model exists, else keywords. keyword: words only. meaning: meaning, falling back to keywords.

project.description: Limit to this project name or id. Omit to search all. Prefer this over project_id.

project_id.description: Limit to this integer project id. Omit to search all. A project name that matches is used instead.

tools.name: search

tools.description: Track bugs and blockers. Prefer log_work(kind=problem) to open one. action=log (write) stores a problem; component_id may be omitted (General is used or created). If review mode holds problems, log is queued instead. action=list (read) returns open problems. action=solve (write) sets status to solved and stores a solution; history undo (record_type=problem) restores the open problem and drops that solution. action=get_tree (read) returns {problem, attempts, solution}, or {} if the id is missing. Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

action.description: log (create), list (read open ones), solve (mark solved) or get_tree (read attempts). Required.

code_snippet.description: solve: code that fixed it, as text. Optional. Do not include secrets.

compact.description: list: true drops empties and timestamps and truncates text (default false).

component_id.description: log: component id. Omit to use or create the project's General component. list: optional filter.

description.description: log: what is wrong, in more detail. Optional.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

problem_id.description: solve and get_tree: problem id. Required for those actions.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

severity.description: log: critical, urgent, normal (default) or low. Older names high and medium also work.

summary.description: solve: what fixed it. Required for solve.

title.description: log: short problem title. Required for log.

That overwrite can be restored with history undo (record_type=attempt). Close the problem with problem action=solve, not with outcome. Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

attempt_id.description: outcome: attempt id to update. Required for outcome.

confidence.description: outcome: attempted (default), worked_once, verified, proven or deprecated.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

outcome.description: outcome: success, failure, partial or abandoned. Required for outcome.

parent_attempt_id.description: log: earlier attempt id this branches from. Optional.

problem_id.description: log: problem id this try is for. Required for log.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

tools.name: attempt

tools.description: Manage todos. Prefer log_work(kind=todo) to add one. action=add creates a todo (optional subtask and blockers). action=update overwrites only the fields you pass; history undo (record_type=todo) restores that edit. A new todo is not deleted by undo: set status done or cancelled. action=list (read) returns rows plus priority_level. action=next (read) returns {next, ready_total, blocked, blocked_total} for open, unblocked, highest-priority todos. action=block / unblock (write) add or remove wait-on links. Review mode may queue an add. Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

blocked_by.description: add/block: todo ids it waits on. unblock: remove only these; omit both blocker fields to remove every blocker.

blocked_by_problem.description: add/block/unblock: a problem id it waits on.

compact.description: list: true drops empties and timestamps and truncates text (default false).

component_id.description: add: component id this todo is about. Optional.

due_date.description: add: due date as text, preferably ISO (2026-10-17). Optional. Not changed by update.

limit.description: next: how many ready todos to return (default 5).

min_priority.description: list: this level or more urgent (critical, urgent, normal, low).

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

parent_todo_id.description: add: make this a subtask of this todo id, in the same project.

priority.description: add/update: critical, urgent, normal (default) or low (high and medium also work). list: only this level.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

project_id.description: add/list/next: project id, or pass project= name. Required for those actions.

status.description: update: pending, in_progress, blocked, done or cancelled. list: only this status.

title.description: add: todo title. Required for add. update: new title.

todo_id.description: update/block/unblock: todo id. Required for those actions.

tools.name: todo

tools.description: Read or close work sessions. A session opens and closes on its own (idle, or when the app quits); do not start one unless you need a manual session. action=start returns the automatic session when one is open ({session_id, automatic: true}); otherwise it creates one. action=end stores summary and outcomes and stops that session from being continued; it is not undone by history. action=current returns the open session or null. action=log_conversation stores a prompt/response summary; if key_decisions is set and review mode holds decisions, a decision is queued instead of the conversation. list_conversations and list_sessions return newest first. Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

action.description: start, end, current (read), log_conversation, list_conversations or list_sessions. Required.

focus_component_id.description: start: component id in focus. Optional. Ignored when an automatic session is reused.

focus_problem_id.description: start: problem id in focus. Optional. Ignored when an automatic session is reused.

key_decisions.description: log_conversation: decision lines. If set, review mode may queue the first as a decision instead.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

project_id.description: start/current/log_conversation/list_*: project id, or project= name. Required except current, where it filters.

session_id.description: end: session id. log_conversation/list_conversations: optional; log defaults to the automatic session.

user_prompt_summary.description: log_conversation: what was asked. Required for that action.

tools.name: session

tools.description: Attach files to a project, component or problem. action=attach (write, this computer only; remote clients are refused) copies file_path into the project bundle when copy_to_bundle is true (default) and returns the attachment row. action=list (read) returns attachment rows; omit filters for all. action=remove (write) deletes the row. delete_file=true also deletes the bundle copy; that file is not restored. The row can be put back with history undo (record_type=attachment). action=search (read) matches indexed snippets, not file bytes, and returns content locations plus file name and path. Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

action.description: attach (copy or reference a file), list (read), remove (delete the row) or search (indexed text). Required.

attachment_id.description: remove: attachment id. Required for remove.

component_id.description: attach: component to hang the file on. list: filter. Optional.

copy_to_bundle.description: attach: true (default) copies into the project bundle; false stores the external path only.

delete_file.description: remove: true also deletes the bundle copy from disk (not restored by undo). Default false.

file_path.description: attach: path on this computer. Required for attach. Missing files error.

file_types.description: search: only these extensions without the dot, e.g. md, py. Optional.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

problem_id.description: attach: problem to hang the file on. list: filter. Optional.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

project_id.description: attach: project id (or project= name). list/search: optional filter.

query.description: search: substring matched against indexed description and snippet. Required for search.

tags.description: attach: tag strings, stored comma-separated. Optional.

user_description.description: attach: why this file matters. Optional.

tools.name: file

tools.description: Git for the FlowState data folder on this computer, not the user's project repository. Remote clients are refused. action=init creates the repo, a .gitignore and README, and an initial commit, or returns status if it exists. action=status (read) returns {initialized, branch, remote_url, pending_changes, last_commit}. action=sync commits non-secret files, then pull --rebase and push when a remote exists; that push is not undone by history. action=set_remote sets or replaces origin. action=clone clones into local_path or the data folder and refuses a non-empty directory. action=history (read) returns commits {hash, message, date, author}, or [] if there is no repo. This is not history (the edit-undo tool) and not the off-site backup.

action.description: init, status (read), sync (commit and maybe push), set_remote, clone or history (read commits). Required.

commit_message.description: sync: commit subject. Omit for 'FlowState sync' plus a timestamp.

local_path.description: clone: directory to clone into. Omit for the FlowState data folder. Refused if not empty.

remote_url.description: set_remote and clone: git URL for origin. Required for those actions.

tools.name: git

tools.description: Store non-secret project settings such as host names and ports. Do not put passwords, tokens or keys here; writes that look like secrets are refused. is_secret only flags the row; list still returns value. action=create returns the row (name is unique per project and category). action=list (read) returns rows. action=update overwrites only fields you pass, or returns null if nothing was passed or the id is missing. action=delete returns true, or false if missing. update and delete can be restored with history undo (record_type=variable). Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

action.description: create, list (read), update or delete. Required.

category.description: create: server, credentials, config, environment, endpoint or custom (default). list: filter. The credentials category is still not for real secrets.

description.description: create/update: what the variable is for. Optional.

is_secret.description: create/update: flag the row as sensitive (default false). The value is still returned by list.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

name.description: create: name, unique in the project and category. Required for create. update: new name.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

project_id.description: create/list: project id (or project= name). Required for those actions.

value.description: create/update: the setting as text. Not a place for secrets.

variable_id.description: update/delete: variable id. Required for those actions.

tools.name: variable

tools.description: Store a reusable procedure for a project (steps, not a one-off decision). Prefer log_work(kind=learning or decision) for a single lesson or choice. action=create returns the method with steps as a list; name is unique in the project. action=list (read) returns methods. action=update overwrites only fields you pass (steps replaces the whole list) or returns null if none were passed. action=delete returns true, or false if missing. update and delete undo with history (record_type=method). Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

action.description: create, list (read), update or delete. Required.

category.description: auth, deployment, testing, architecture, workflow, convention, api, security or other. list: filter.

code_example.description: create/update: optional sample code. Do not include secrets.

description.description: create: what the procedure is. Required for create. update: new text.

method_id.description: update/delete: method id. Required for those actions.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

name.description: create: name, unique in the project. Required for create. update: new name.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

project_id.description: create/list: project id (or project= name). Required for those actions.

related_component_id.description: create/update: component id this procedure belongs to. Optional.

steps.description: create/update: ordered step strings. update replaces the whole list.

tools.name: method

tools.description: Record this app's learned skills, a checkpoint, or a quality metric. Not a substitute for log_work (that is the user's project memory). action=learn_skill (write) inserts a skill row. action=get_skills (read) lists them. action=confirm_skill (write) increments the session count and may set promoted when sessions are at least 3 and the success rate is at least 0.8; history undo restores the skill row. action=save_state (write) stores a checkpoint and returns it. action=get_state (read) returns the latest checkpoint or null. action=log_metric (write) stores one score. action=get_metrics (read) returns recent metric rows. New skills, states and metrics are not deleted by undo. Write: requires project="<name>" (or project_id).

action.description: learn_skill, get_skills (read), confirm_skill, save_state, get_state (read), log_metric or get_metrics (read). Required.

active_component_ids.description: save_state: component ids in progress. Optional.

active_problem_ids.description: save_state: problem ids in progress. Optional.

context.description: learn_skill: when this applies. log_metric: where the score was taken. Optional.

focus_summary.description: save_state: what the session was doing. Optional.

key_facts.description: save_state: fact lines to keep. Optional.

metric_type.description: log_metric: checkpoint_timing, tool_choice, response_quality, prediction_accuracy or user_satisfaction. Required for log_metric. get_metrics: optional filter.

model.description: Your model name, if you know it (optional; never guessed)

outcome.description: log_metric: what happened. Optional. Not the attempt outcome enum.

pending_decisions.description: save_state: decisions not made yet. Optional.

project.description: Project name or id. Required for every write.

project_id.description: learn_skill/get_skills/save_state/get_state/log_metric: project id (or project=). get_skills includes global skills. Required for save_state and get_state.

promoted_only.description: get_skills: true returns only promoted skills (default false).

skill.description: learn_skill: what was learned. Required for learn_skill.

skill_id.description: confirm_skill: skill id. Required for confirm_skill.

skill_type.description: learn_skill: tool_capability, user_preference, approach, gotcha or project_specific. Required for learn_skill. get_skills: optional filter.

tool_name.description: learn_skill: tool this skill is about. get_skills: optional filter.

tools.name: self_improve
